CREATE TABLE `glpi_entities` (
  `id` bigint(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `name` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `entities_id` bigint(20) DEFAULT 0,
  `completename` longtext DEFAULT NULL,
  `comment` longtext DEFAULT NULL,
  `level` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `sons_cache` longtext DEFAULT NULL,
  `ancestors_cache` longtext DEFAULT NULL,
  `address` longtext DEFAULT NULL,
  `postcode` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `town` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `state` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `country` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `website` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `phonenumber` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `fax` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `email` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `admin_email` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `admin_email_name` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `admin_reply` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `admin_reply_name` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `notification_subject_tag` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `ldap_dn` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `tag` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `authldaps_id` bigint(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `mail_domain` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `entity_ldapfilter` longtext DEFAULT NULL,
  `mailing_signature` longtext DEFAULT NULL,
  `cartridges_alert_repeat` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT -2,
  `consumables_alert_repeat` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT -2,
  `use_licenses_alert` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT -2,
  `send_licenses_alert_before_delay` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT -2,
  `use_certificates_alert` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT -2,
  `send_certificates_alert_before_delay` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT -2,
  `use_contracts_alert` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT -2,
  `send_contracts_alert_before_delay` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT -2,
  `use_infocoms_alert` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT -2,
  `send_infocoms_alert_before_delay` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT -2,
  `use_reservations_alert` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT -2,
  `use_domains_alert` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT -2,
  `send_domains_alert_close_expiries_delay` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT -2,
  `send_domains_alert_expired_delay` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT -2,
  `autoclose_delay` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT -2,
  `autopurge_delay` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT -10,
  `notclosed_delay` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT -2,
  `calendars_id` bigint(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `auto_assign_mode` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT -2,
  `tickettype` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT -2,
  `max_closedate` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `inquest_config` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT -2,
  `inquest_rate` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `inquest_delay` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT -10,
  `inquest_URL` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `autofill_warranty_date` varchar(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '-2',
  `autofill_use_date` varchar(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '-2',
  `autofill_buy_date` varchar(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '-2',
  `autofill_delivery_date` varchar(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '-2',
  `autofill_order_date` varchar(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '-2',
  `tickettemplates_id` bigint(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `changetemplates_id` bigint(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `problemtemplates_id` bigint(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `entities_id_software` bigint(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `default_contract_alert` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT -2,
  `default_infocom_alert` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT -2,
  `default_cartridges_alarm_threshold` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT -2,
  `default_consumables_alarm_threshold` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT -2,
  `delay_send_emails` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT -2,
  `is_notif_enable_default` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT -2,
  `inquest_duration` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `date_mod` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `date_creation` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `autofill_decommission_date` varchar(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '-2',
  `suppliers_as_private` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT -2,
  `anonymize_support_agents` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT -2,
  `enable_custom_css` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT -2,
  `custom_css_code` longtext DEFAULT NULL,
  `latitude` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `longitude` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `altitude` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `ldap_mode` varchar(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'explicit',
  `calendar_mode` varchar(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'inherit',
  `tickettemplate_mode` varchar(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'inherit',
  `changetemplate_mode` varchar(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'inherit',
  `problemtemplate_mode` varchar(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'inherit',
  `software_entity_mode` varchar(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'inherit',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `unicity` (`entities_id`,`name`),
  KEY `entities_id` (`entities_id`),
  KEY `date_mod` (`date_mod`),
  KEY `date_creation` (`date_creation`),
  KEY `tickettemplates_id` (`tickettemplates_id`),
  KEY `changetemplates_id` (`changetemplates_id`),
  KEY `problemtemplates_id` (`problemtemplates_id`),
  KEY `fk_entities_authldaps_id` (`authldaps_id`),
  KEY `fk_entities_calendars_id` (`calendars_id`),
  KEY `fk_entities_entities_id_software` (`entities_id_software`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_entities_authldaps_id` FOREIGN KEY (`authldaps_id`) REFERENCES `glpi_authldaps` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_entities_calendars_id` FOREIGN KEY (`calendars_id`) REFERENCES `glpi_calendars` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_entities_changetemplates_id` FOREIGN KEY (`changetemplates_id`) REFERENCES `glpi_changetemplates` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_entities_entities_id` FOREIGN KEY (`entities_id`) REFERENCES `glpi_entities` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_entities_entities_id_software` FOREIGN KEY (`entities_id_software`) REFERENCES `glpi_entities` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_entities_problemtemplates_id` FOREIGN KEY (`problemtemplates_id`) REFERENCES `glpi_problemtemplates` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_entities_tickettemplates_id` FOREIGN KEY (`tickettemplates_id`) REFERENCES `glpi_tickettemplates` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `glpi_entities_ldap_mode_selection` CHECK (`ldap_mode` in ('explicit','inherit') and (`ldap_mode` = 'explicit' and (`authldaps_id` is null or `authldaps_id` > 0) or `ldap_mode` <> 'explicit' and `authldaps_id` is null)),
  CONSTRAINT `glpi_entities_calendar_mode_selection` CHECK (`calendar_mode` in ('explicit','inherit') and (`calendar_mode` = 'explicit' and (`calendars_id` is null or `calendars_id` > 0) or `calendar_mode` <> 'explicit' and `calendars_id` is null)),
  CONSTRAINT `glpi_entities_tickettemplate_mode_selection` CHECK (`tickettemplate_mode` in ('explicit','inherit') and (`tickettemplate_mode` = 'explicit' and (`tickettemplates_id` is null or `tickettemplates_id` > 0) or `tickettemplate_mode` <> 'explicit' and `tickettemplates_id` is null)),
  CONSTRAINT `glpi_entities_changetemplate_mode_selection` CHECK (`changetemplate_mode` in ('explicit','inherit') and (`changetemplate_mode` = 'explicit' and (`changetemplates_id` is null or `changetemplates_id` > 0) or `changetemplate_mode` <> 'explicit' and `changetemplates_id` is null)),
  CONSTRAINT `glpi_entities_problemtemplate_mode_selection` CHECK (`problemtemplate_mode` in ('explicit','inherit') and (`problemtemplate_mode` = 'explicit' and (`problemtemplates_id` is null or `problemtemplates_id` > 0) or `problemtemplate_mode` <> 'explicit' and `problemtemplates_id` is null)),
  CONSTRAINT `glpi_entities_software_entity_mode_selection` CHECK (`software_entity_mode` in ('explicit','inherit','unchanged') and (`software_entity_mode` = 'explicit' and `entities_id_software` is not null and `entities_id_software` >= 0 or `software_entity_mode` <> 'explicit' and `entities_id_software` is null)),
  CONSTRAINT `glpi_entities_parent_root` CHECK (`id` = 0 and `entities_id` is null or `id` > 0 and `entities_id` is not null and `entities_id` >= 0 and `entities_id` <> `id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3 COLLATE=utf8mb3_unicode_ci

CREATE TABLE `glpi_slms` (
  `id` bigint(20) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `name` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `entities_id` bigint(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `is_recursive` smallint(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `comment` longtext DEFAULT NULL,
  `calendars_id` bigint(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `date_mod` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `date_creation` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `use_ticket_calendar` tinyint(4) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `name` (`name`),
  KEY `entities_id` (`entities_id`),
  KEY `is_recursive` (`is_recursive`),
  KEY `calendars_id` (`calendars_id`),
  KEY `date_mod` (`date_mod`),
  KEY `date_creation` (`date_creation`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_slms_calendars_id` FOREIGN KEY (`calendars_id`) REFERENCES `glpi_calendars` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_slms_entities_id` FOREIGN KEY (`entities_id`) REFERENCES `glpi_entities` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `glpi_slms_calendar_selection` CHECK (`calendars_id` is null or `calendars_id` > 0 and `use_ticket_calendar` = 0),
  CONSTRAINT `glpi_slms_is_recursive_boolean` CHECK (`is_recursive` is not null and `is_recursive` in (0,1)),
  CONSTRAINT `glpi_slms_use_ticket_calendar_boolean` CHECK (`use_ticket_calendar` is not null and `use_ticket_calendar` in (0,1))
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=181 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3 COLLATE=utf8mb3_unicode_ci
